subject: POC kickoff: setup blockers & priority check-in
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Sam Greer <sam.greer@finovate.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff: setup blockers & priority check-in

Hi Sam — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we don’t lose momentum: 

• Goal: Validate Redwood inference for short-sequence customer support routing (target 10k queries/day test).
• Current blockers we heard: SSO integration, security questionnaire still in review, and trial VM not spun up by your infra team.

Proposed next steps (short, actionable):
1) Your infra: approve the temporary VM we shared (instructions attached) — ETA: 2–3 business days
2) We provide an SSO guide and point person (I can loop in Marissa) — action: indicate SAML vs OIDC
3) We provision the trial capacity and send API key (we’ll hold until infra confirms)

I attached a one-page POC-Kickoff-Checklist and our onboarding guide to make the setup frictionless. If this is still a Q1 priority for you, can you confirm: (a) who owns SSO (name/email), and (b) whether security can sign off on the temporary VM this week? If timeline slipped, let me know and we’ll adjust.

If it helps, I’m happy to book a 15-min setup call with your infra next week.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: POC-Kickoff-Checklist.xlsx (stated), redwood-onboarding-guide.pdf (stated)
